proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING PLASTIC POLLUTION
proposals.proponent: As You Sow, on behalf of Mr. Winston Dines
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report to shareholders, at reasonable cost and omitting proprietary information, on plastic pollution, disclosing trends in pellet releases and assessing effectiveness of policies to reduce plastic contamination.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD RECOMMENDS THAT YOU VOTE AGAINST THE PROPOSAL.
